standards: Structure
RC frame with brick infill; timber roof/floor framing common
RC frame (columns, beams, slabs); steel roof framing; no timber framing
Termites and humidity destroy timber; RC + steel is durable and insurable
Exterior Walls
Single-skin red clay brick or thin block, cement render, no insulation
LGS stud infill in RC frame, mineral-wool cavity, fiber-cement sheathing, ventilated rainscreen (white lime render or charred timber)
Rainscreen + insulation cut heat gain and AC load; termite-proof, light, straight
Interior Partitions
Clay brick / block, rendered
LGS studs with moisture-resistant fiber-cement board (SCG Smartboard / Shera); double stud + 2 layers board at studio + bedrooms
Lighter, straighter, quieter; termite-proof; easy service routing
Wall Finish
Cement render, emulsion paint
AR mesh tape, lime plaster skim, textured finish (TBD), mineral paint, white
Crack-resistant joints; breathable, resists mould
Trim + Cabinetry
Ornate or stained trim; freestanding overlay cabinet boxes
Plain square-edge baseboards + casings painted white; all cabinetry built-in, flush inset or recessed
Clean, simple lines; no dust traps or gaps
Concrete Walls
Poured where convenient
RC only for frame, pool, retaining walls, cisterns, engineer-required shear walls
Less embodied carbon and heat mass where not needed
Roof
Metal sheet or tile on timber/steel, foil at best, little insulation
Metal over radiant barrier, 75 mm insulation, ventilated cavity
Hot-roof heat is the #1 cooling load; quiet in monsoon rain
Traps
Bottle traps or none; floor drains often untrapped (smell)
P-trap on every fixture; deep-seal trapped floor drains with trap primers
Stops sewer gas, insects and odours
Venting
Often unvented; drains glug and siphon traps
Proper vent stack system through the roof
Keeps trap seals; fast, quiet drainage
Grease
Kitchen waste straight to sewer/septic
Kitchen grease interceptor GT-1 before septic
Protects septic + ATU and drain field
Water Supply
PVC cold + mixed fittings, rarely tested
PPR fusion-welded, pressure-tested before walls close
No hidden leaks; rated for hot water
Electrical
Partial earthing, RCD on some circuits, ad-hoc panel
TN-C-S earthing, 30 mA RCBO on all circuits, full panel schedule
Shock + fire safety in a wet climate
Wet Areas
Tile on render; leaks common
Waterproofing membrane in all wet areas, flood-tested 24 h
Prevents leaks and mould into stud cavities
Hot Water
Point-of-use electric heaters at each shower
Central heat-pump water heater + recirculation
~3x more efficient; one serviceable unit; instant hot water
